Hi Rishi,

Sorry to bug you first thing — finance over here is reconciling our April statements and we show a credit related to Redwood invoices (Q1 volume rebate + duplicate charge reversal). We think part of this is VAT reclaimable for our UK entity.

Can you share the underlying invoices and any VAT/supporting docs we need to include with our reclaim? We also need to understand any AR aging flags on your side before we apply the credit to open invoices.

I've attached a zip with our internal payment remittance and the vendor request form (VAT_support.zip). Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Quick summary of what we'll provide for your reclaim and our internal plan:
- Attached: RWI_AR_aging_202604.xlsx (sheet: open_items, credits, aging buckets) and VAT_claim_template.xlsx (pre-populated with invoice lines).

- Action items for Acme: confirm which invoice numbers you intend to offset vs. cash refund. If you offset, we need your offset mapping so we can mark the receivables as cleared on our side.

Forwarding Emily's thread. Rishi attached an AR aging export; I'm attaching it here as well.

Quick context for finance: Acme wants to either offset the credit against open invoices or receive a cash refund. If we offset, we need to decide whether to:

1) Apply credit directly to AR (reduce open receivables) — simple clear of customer balance, rev recognized unchanged (preferred for small corrections).
2) Post contra-revenue journal (reduce revenue recognized historically) — required if rebate should adjust prior period revenue per our rev recognition policy and materiality threshold.

Per policy, anything > $25k that affects a closed month should be reviewed by accounting leadership. Estimated value on Acme credits: ~£34,200 (gross, incl. VAT).

Michael/Aditya: can you review the attached AR extract and propose the journal entries if we decide option 2? If option 1, confirm the GL clearing accounts we should use and whether we need a memo for SOX trail.

Thanks,
Monica
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: RWI_AR_aging_202604.xlsx

Monica — quick read and proposed treatment below. See attached CSV with draft journal lines (journal_entries_draft.csv).

Facts considered:
- Gross credit (incl. VAT): GBP 34,200
- Net credit (ex-VAT): GBP 28,500
- VAT component: GBP 5,700
- Revenues originally recognized in Feb/Mar 2026 periods (closed).

Recommendation (option 2 — contra-revenue):
- Post contra-revenue to revenue clearing account (GL 4100-CR) for GBP 28,500 to adjust recognized revenue.
- Post VAT payable reversal entry for GBP 5,700 to VAT payable (GL 2202) to reflect VAT credit.
- Offset receivable when Acme confirms offset mapping; if cash refund instead, post AR reduction and cash payment.
- Include reference: ACME-REBATE-0426 in memo and attach supporting docs (VAT_support.zip).

Journal lines (high level):
1) Dr Revenue (4100) GBP 28,500 
   Cr Revenue Clearing (4100-CR) GBP 28,500
2) Dr VAT Payable (2202) GBP 5,700
   Cr VAT Receivable/Credit (1250) GBP 5,700

Control notes: require approval from Laura (accounting lead) for any prior-period contra. If Laura OKs, Monica to schedule posting in Q2 close window and tag memo for audit.

Michael Grant
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai
